# java.maven's lockfile: reused while the request is unchanged, even with
# the repository's POMs gone; `frozen` refuses an outdated one; and a
# library asking for an artifact the lockfile lacks gets a clear error.
[!exec:javac] skip

bit greeting
cp greeting/build/greeting.jar repo/com/example/greeting/1.0/greeting-1.0.jar

bit app
stdout 'deps │ resolving 1 artifacts'
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
cp maven.lock.json first.lock.json

# Forced to run with an unchanged request, java.maven uses the lockfile and
# the cached jars rather than resolving again.
rm repo
bit --force deps
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'
! stdout 'resolving'
cmp maven.lock.json first.lock.json

# A changed request with `frozen` fails rather than resolving.
cp BUILD.frozen BUILD.bit
! bit deps
stderr 'maven\.lock\.json is out of date, and `frozen` is set'
cmp maven.lock.json first.lock.json
! bit fresh
stderr 'fresh\.lock\.json does not exist, and `frozen` is set'
! exists fresh.lock.json

# An artifact the lockfile lacks.
cp BUILD.absent BUILD.bit
! bit app
stderr '`com\.example:absent` is not in the lockfile: add it to the `artifacts` of the java\.maven target'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit greeting = java.library {
  dir = "greeting"
}

deps = java.maven {
  artifacts    = ["com.example:greeting:1.0"]
  repositories = ["file://#{project_dir()}/repo"]
}

explicit app = java.library {
  dir   = "app"
  maven = ["com.example:greeting"]
  lock  = deps.lock
}
-- BUILD.frozen --
deps = java.maven {
  artifacts    = ["com.example:greeting:1.0", "com.example:other:1.0"]
  repositories = ["file://#{project_dir()}/repo"]
  frozen       = true
}

explicit fresh = java.maven {
  artifacts    = ["com.example:greeting:1.0"]
  repositories = ["file://#{project_dir()}/repo"]
  lock         = "fresh.lock.json"
  frozen       = true
}
-- BUILD.absent --
deps = java.maven {
  artifacts    = ["com.example:greeting:1.0"]
  repositories = ["file://#{project_dir()}/repo"]
}

explicit app = java.library {
  dir   = "app"
  maven = ["com.example:greeting", "com.example:absent"]
  lock  = deps.lock
}
-- repo/com/example/greeting/1.0/greeting-1.0.pom --
<project>
  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
  <artifactId>greeting</artifactId>
  <version>1.0</version>
</project>
-- greeting/src/main/java/com/example/greeting/Greeting.java --
package com.example.greeting;

public class Greeting {
    public static String word() {
        return "hello";
    }
}
-- app/src/main/java/demo/Main.java --
package demo;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(com.example.greeting.Greeting.word());
    }
}
